reviews.x: This brush works wonders. My car has very thick hair and she gets lots of knots and clumps. With this brush you literally see the hair combing right off. I used to have to use Scissors to cut the clumps out. I’m recommending this brush to anyone with long hair pets.

reviews.t: My Maine Coon Cat LOVES This!
reviews.x: I bought this because we are first-time Maine Coon owners with two sister kitties. Keeping knots out of their long hair is an ongoing task! This brush/detangler works amazingly well! And one of our kitties comes running to me when she sees that I have it out. She actually looks like she’s smiling when I brush her with it! And both kitties’ fur is super soft. It is a great addition to our grooming tools.
Great product! My dog loves this. Brushing did a great job! It gets a lot of the undercoat out and my dog loved every second of it.

We have a Great Pyrenees & this is a great tool. Brushes into the coat very nicely to get down to business. This brush REALLY removes the excess. It’s not a one size fits all. You will still need a grooming brush but this will remove all the deeper hard to get at fur in a kind way.

reviews.t: This helped tame my cat’s coarse coat
reviews.x: I have a Nebelung and his coat always looked a little different than other long haired cats. I assume that’s because he has a more coarse coat. Regular brushes still left him looking a bit scraggly. But this brush has his coat looking nice and fluffy. He sheds a little bit and this helps with that too. I think this would be good if you had a cat with a coat you wanted to thin out.  First pic is before we started using the brush and the second pic is after

I’m stunned. 😳 I’ve had a long haired cat for 9 years. He’s always been pretty well groomed. As he’s aged his matting he’s become terrible. This tool has been my answer for helping my guy out. He had four really huge mats and this tool pulled it out no problems. I couldn’t believe it. He’s such a handsome man now! If you have a long haired cat or dog just buy this! Dewey has found his magic tool! ❤️❤️❤️ Don’t walk….run!

The brush didn't demat the bad mats on my cat, it was very rough and pulled the hair really bad, and caused her a lot if pain, I ended up having to use a cat comb, but after she was de matted I used the brush to thin out my cats coat. It's very useful but does pull, used on my dog as well and the pulling and grabbing was too much for both my cat and dog.

reviews.t: No need to shave the dog!
reviews.x: WOW! We have an older dog that we adopted that sheds like a maniac! This thing works great to get deep down and get all that loose hair. But then I used it on my cat - I thought the poor thing has exploded!! Cat hair went everywhere!! Holy cow! So now I know to use this OUTSide with the cat. 😂

I’ve been using the Furminator for years. I saw an ad for this tool and was skeptical. It does a WAY better job than the Furminator because of its design. I get a lot more of my dogs undercoat with this tool. Definitely recommend!

My friend let me use her brush on my long haired dachshund and with ease I created another dog with the hair brushed out. This is much more gentle than the furminator and does a great job removing loose hairs.

reviews.t: Saving our vacuum one brush at a time.
reviews.x: This is amazing. I remove a small dog’s worth of hair every time I use this on my golden. It helps us keep dog hair out of the house and off our floors.
This a good product but pulls tough knots really hard causes discomfort for my poor kitty. It does it job but for bad matting no Bueno
I’m impressed how i was able to remove 2 huge mats on my poodles head. This brush along with “the stuff” dog detangler, perfect due!

reviews.t: My blue healer loves the brush..
reviews.x: I have had dogs all my life. Best brush I have found. Have a blue healer and it works fantastic.

reviews.t: Where has this been all my dog’s life?
reviews.x: Like most folks with a fuzzy dog, keeping her coat brushed and healthy can be a challenge. I’d been using the “popular” product, but by the time the dog (she’s 100 pounds) was half brushed, I was TIRED. My trainer suggested this. WOW! First, the dog fell asleep while I used it. Second, I got a tremendous amount of loose fur off just by brushing—no parting the hair, working in tiny sections, just brush the dog with gentle, long strokes. It does a MUCH better job than that more expensive, popular

reviews.t: Great for undercoats and simple mats
reviews.x: I bought this because my cat went out the snow and got a bad case of matted fur.  It actually took out a lot of undercoat fur and detangled simple mats, which is good as we are coming out of winter and he is shedding like crazy. Unfortunately, it will not take care of clumpy/severe matts. I am slowly shaving/cutting those off my cat so he can start with a fresh fur this spring. I am still rating it a 5 star though bec I do not think it was meant for severe/clumped matted fur that's close to the

I have a German Shepard and as many know they shed a lot. This brush makes it so much easier to get all of the loose fur up and de-shed her, which creates a second dog because of all of the fur that comes off. I had a different brush at first and thought it got all of her loose fur off but when I purchased this brush I realized just how much loose fur she had. I highly recommend this brush it is able to get most if not all of the extra fur off of her.

whoever invented this tool was a genius!  I have used many tools on my dogs (and had many) and it didn't get the hair I wanted to get out.  this tool is the best I have ever used. easy to use.  sturdy.  seems like my babies don't mind me combing them out. this tool gets more hair out that I ever did before. I can't say enough about this tool.  if you are looking for a tool to get your dogs hair out-BUY THIS!  you won't be sorry

Have had several different brushes and found out about this one at a dog wash place, used it there and was very happy how it did, unlike the furanator (sp) this is a breeze to clean and doesn't pull the hair as much. Gets tons of hair off both dogs, will throw away all the other brushs

reviews.t: Works well but makes a mess
reviews.x: This works very well and my dogs actually sit super still to be brushed. I have two Australian shepherds, so they shed a lot, but this product does not all stay on the brush while brushing. Hair is everywhere! I still really like this brush

I could not believe how well this comb works!  As the owner of a long-haired German Shepherd, I can easily rate this comb as the best ever, and I think I own one of every kind available.  Now if you could make the girls enjoy it ...

reviews.t: Not intended for my designer Bagle
reviews.x: My furbaby sheds a lot. Thought this would help. It did not. My neighbor has a Burmese Mountain dog pup. I gave it to them because when his coat finally grows in they will need it!
This works great on our Siberian husky and husky/German Shepard mix. Get so much hair from the undercoat that would usually shed all over my house. Definitely recommend!

reviews.t: jAc Brush for Shedding Cats & Dogs
reviews.x: This is a product that lives up to the hype! It is such a help with my very foofy long haired cat. It helps remove matting and knots. I highly recommend this product!
I seriously didn't realize my cat had THAT much fur. There was apparently another cats worth of fur in her. Great brush love the duel sides. Seems really sturdy.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the brush for effectively removing loose hair and undercoat, often describing large amounts of fur being removed.
Many reviewers report success detangling or removing mats, including large mats, from long-haired pets.
Several reviewers say their pets tolerate or even enjoy the brush, with some pets coming to them or falling asleep during brushing.
A few reviewers note the brush can pull hard on tough knots and cause discomfort or pain, especially with bad matting.
Some reviewers compare it favorably to the Furminator, saying it does a better or gentler job.
